Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
Aaron_1: brother of Moses (Exodus 4:14) and Levitical priest (Exodus 28:1)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Samuel_2: son of Elkanah and Hannah (1 Samuel 1:20)
Josiah_1: prophesied son of the house of David (1 Kings 13:2), King of Judah and son of Amon (2 Kings 21:24)
Hilkiah_2: the high priest of King Josiah's reign (2 Kings 22:4, 2 Chronicles 34:9)
Heman_2: the singer, son of Joel_1, decendant of Kohath (1 Chronicles 6:33), father of fourteen sons and three daughter (1 Chronicles 25:5)
Asaph_3: father of Zichri (1 Chronicles 9:15), singer (Ezra 2:41, Nehemiah 7:44)
Nethanel_4: the scribe, father of Shemaiah (1 Chronicles 24:6)
Hashabiah_3: chief officer for the Levites, son of Kemuel (1 Chronicles 27:17)
Conaniah_1: officer in charge of the consecrated things (2 Chronicles 31:12)
Jozabad_4: overseer of the consecrated things under Conaniah (2 Chronicles 31:13)
Shemaiah_12: distributed portions to their brothers (2 Chronicles 31:15)
Zechariah_15: foreman over reconstruction of the Temple during Josiah's reign (2 Chronicles 34:12)
Jeremiah_6: the prophet (2 Chronicles 36:12), son of Hilkiah (Jeremiah 1:1)
